product_overview: Clawback Shield helps people understand and respond to Social Security overpayment notices. Users can paste or upload a notice for a plain-English explanation, access checklists and guides, and manage waiver cases with follow-up tools.
core_goals: Understand a Social Security overpayment notice in plain English
Generate a draft response letter based on a notice
Use a checklist to prepare for responding to an overpayment notice
Start and manage a waiver case, including filing and follow-up tracking
View pricing, guides, and support information

features.name: Notice analysis
features.description: Users can paste or upload an SSA overpayment notice to get a plain-English summary, key dates, options, and a draft letter.
user_flows: Navigate to /analyze -> Paste notice text into the notice field -> Request an explanation -> See the summary, amount, key dates, options, and draft letter -> Copy or download the draft letter
Navigate to /analyze -> Choose a notice file to upload -> Request an explanation -> See the analysis results with the draft letter
Navigate to /analyze -> Select the sample notice option -> Review the sample text populated in the notice field -> Request an explanation -> See the analysis results
Navigate to /analyze -> Paste a notice with an overpayment amount around $2,000 or less -> Request an explanation -> See the phone-waiver guidance in the result

features.name: Emailing the notice summary
features.description: Users can opt to receive the notice summary by email after submitting an analysis request.
user_flows: Navigate to /analyze -> Enable email delivery for the summary -> Paste notice text or upload a file -> Request an explanation -> See the delivery status message under the result

features.name: Free response checklist
features.description: Users can read a free checklist that helps them prepare a response to a clawback notice and optionally share an email for updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /checklist -> Read the checklist items -> Submit an email address to join the signup list

features.name: Test code login
features.description: Users can sign in with a test code to access the account area without a standard email sign-in flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Open the test code sign-in option -> Enter a test code -> Submit the code -> Arrive at the account page
Navigate to /login -> Open the test code sign-in option -> Enter an invalid test code -> Submit the code -> See the invalid-code message

features.name: Account dashboard
features.description: Signed-in users can view their plan, remaining analyses, and saved analysis history, then sign out.
user_flows: Navigate to /account -> View plan details and remaining analysis count -> Open a saved analysis from history -> Return to the account dashboard
Navigate to /account -> Review saved analysis history -> Sign out

features.name: Case intake for waiver requests
features.description: Signed-in users can start a waiver case, including a family-helper mode for assisting a parent.
user_flows: Navigate to /cases/new -> Enable the option for helping a parent -> Enter the beneficiary name and other intake details -> Start a waiver case
Navigate to /cases/new -> Leave the helper option off -> Enter the required intake details -> Start a waiver case

features.name: Case timeline and withholding-pause letter
features.description: Signed-in users can unlock a case, mark it as filed, log SSA calls, add decision notes, and download a withholding-pause letter.
user_flows: Navigate to a case page -> Unlock the case -> Fill in the filing date and filing method -> Mark the case as filed -> Log the SSA call note -> Add the SSA decision to the log -> Download the withholding-pause letter
Navigate to a case page -> Unlock the case -> Download the withholding-pause letter

features.name: Pricing and plan comparison
features.description: Users can review available plans, one-time case pricing, monthly notice-watch pricing, and help pricing.
user_flows: Navigate to /pricing -> Review the available plans and pricing -> Open the phone-waiver information link

features.name: Done-with-you help inquiry
features.description: Users can view and request information about paid help services.
user_flows: Navigate to /help -> Review the help offering details

features.name: SEO guide pages
features.description: Users can open educational guide pages about waivers, SSA-632 help, stopping withholding, and phone waivers.
user_flows: Navigate to /waiver-by-phone -> Read the guide content -> Use the page call-to-action to continue to notice review
Navigate to /social-security-overpayment-waiver -> Read the guide content -> Use the page call-to-action to continue to notice review
Navigate to /ssa-632-guide -> Read the guide content -> Use the page call-to-action to continue to notice review
Navigate to /stop-overpayment-withholding -> Read the guide content -> Use the page call-to-action to continue to notice review

routes.description: Landing page with hero, how it works, pricing (test mode), email signup
The Read my notice page - paste or upload (PDF, TXT, image) an SSA overpayment notice and get a plain-English summary, key dates, options and a draft letter
Free clawback response checklist with email capture
Email magic-link sign-in (shows "Email sign-in opens soon" when email is not configured) and "Have a test code?" demo login
Plan, remaining analyses, plans list, saved analysis history, sign out
Pricing - free notice read, Waiver Case $299 per case one-time, Notice Watch $19/mo, done-with-you help from $599; free phone-waiver note
Case intake with "I'm helping a parent" toggle (beneficiary name field, family-helper wording)
Case view - unlock ($299 or case credit), After you file case timeline (mark filed, log SSA call, decision log) and withholding-pause letter download
SEO guide page about free phone waivers for overpayments around $2,000 or less

features.name: Helping a parent intake
features.description: On /cases/new toggle "I'm helping a parent"; shows "Beneficiary's name" field and helper wording; landing hero CTA "Fight Mom or Dad's clawback"
user_interactions: Fill "Beneficiary's name" and other intake fields

features.name: Case timeline and pause letter
features.description: After unlocking a case (demo account has case credits), the "After you file" section lets user Mark as filed (date + method), Log a call with SSA, Add to decision log, and download the withholding-pause letter (.txt)
user_interactions: Fill "Date sent", choose method, click "Mark as filed"
Choose "What SSA said", click "Add to decision log"

features.name: Pricing and phone-waiver note
features.description: /pricing shows Waiver Case $299 per case, Notice Watch $19/mo (no free case packets), help from $599, and a phone-waiver tip; /analyze shows "Good news - this may be fixable with a free phone call" for amounts around $2,000 or less

features.name: SEO guide pages
features.description: Four public guide pages with headings, FAQ and CTA to read a notice, linked from sitemap
user_interactions: Open each guide page and click its call-to-action

features.name: Notice analysis (paste)
features.description: Paste notice text and click "Explain it" to get summary, amount, key dates, options, draft letter
user_interactions: See result with amount, key dates, options and DRAFT letter
Copy or download the draft letter

features.name: Notice analysis (file upload)
features.description: Upload a PDF, TXT or PNG/JPG notice; sample files at /samples/sample-notice.pdf, /samples/sample-notice.txt, /samples/sample-notice.png
user_interactions: Choose file in "Upload notice file" input

features.name: Try a sample notice
features.description: Link that fills the textarea with a fictional sample notice

features.name: Email me the summary
features.description: Checkbox; guests are invited to sign in, signed-in users see a status message (email delivery not yet configured)
user_interactions: Submit and see status message under result

features.name: Test code login
features.description: On /login open "Have a test code?", enter code, sign in as demo@clawbackshield.test (Caregiver plan)
user_interactions: Wrong code shows "That test code isn't valid."

features.name: Email sign-in request
features.description: Enter email; without email provider shows "Email sign-in opens soon"

features.name: Account and history
features.description: Shows plan, remaining analyses, saved analyses, sign out

features.name: Checklist and email signup
features.description: Free checklist page and email capture

known_limitations.issue: Guests get 1 analysis per day per IP; tests needing many analyses should sign in with the test code first
known_limitations.impact: Second guest analysis shows a limit message with "Sign in free"

known_limitations.issue: Payments (Stripe) and email delivery (Resend) are not configured
known_limitations.impact: Plan upgrade buttons do not charge; no emails are sent
